source: claude/precision-macroblock3-manifest-content-readiness-contract-2026-10-02.md §4 (as corrected by the Macroblock 4 hygiene fix, 2026-10-02)

label.es: ¿Quién operará la logística día a día?

fields.notes: Gates applicability of several downstream fields (3PL-specific questions only make sense once this is known) — a true level-1 gate, not merely informational.

label.es: Tipo principal de producto a mover

fields.notes: At least one item required for completeness (minimum-length rule, §6.3 of the source document).

fields.normalization_hint: free text, but prompts for capacity unit (m²/pallets) and location preference explicitly

label.en: Do any flows involve hazardous/regulated materials?

fields.notes: Blocking because a "yes" here changes compliance-document requirements materially; a wrong "no" here is the material-contradiction scenario in §9.2 of the source document.

label.en: Does any flow require cold-chain/temperature control?
label.es: ¿Algún flujo requiere cadena de frío/control de temperatura?

fields.applicability_rule_note: real rule (§4.1): applicable iff any logistics_flows item has an origin and a destination in different countries — a comparison BETWEEN two sibling sub-fields of the same repeatable_group item, which critical-decisions.ts's ResolutionRule AST does not attempt to express (that module's own scope, per the Macroblock 4 brief, is critical_decisions[].resolution_rule, not every field's applicability_rule). Left as a deliberate, explicit prose rule rather than a fabricated AST node; the engine-build macroblock that implements evaluateReadiness() is the right place to decide whether applicability_rule gets its own small AST or a different mechanism.

label.es: Estado de contratación de agente aduanal

fields.applicability_rule_note: real rule (§4.1): applicable iff logistics_import_export_license_status is applicable (cross-border flow exists) AND logistics_operating_responsibility != third_party_logistics — left as prose for the same reason as logistics_import_export_license_status above (depends on that field's own not-yet-AST-encoded applicability).

label.es: Estado de cobertura de seguro de carga
Sensibilidad de costos / notas de presupuesto

fields.notes: Visibility-sensitive — see visibility_rules below. May contain counterparty-identifying free text; passes through the Visibility Resolver's project-scoped redaction pass.

label.en: Interest in a VAT-deferment-on-import scheme, where one exists
label.es: Interés en un esquema de diferimiento de IVA en importación, donde exista

fields.notes: [Macroblock 4 hygiene fix, 2026-10-02] Genuinely base-schema content, now present as a real fields[] entry rather than only being referenced from country_overlays[*].deactivate. Base: applicable; deactivated by the US and MX overlays below (both lack a comparable deferred-VAT-on-import scheme relevant to this pilot's scope); NOT deactivated by the DE overlay (Germany, as an EU VAT-system country, has a genuine referent for it).

label.es: Ruta de cumplimiento de materiales peligrosos confirmada

label.en: Hazmat flag consistent with described products
label.es: Bandera de materiales peligrosos consistente con productos descritos

critical_decisions.notes: Material-contradiction worked example, §9.2 of the source document. logistics_hazmat_ack is a new field (type=text, requirement_level=conditional) surfaced only once evaluateQuality() flags this specific tension — not listed in fields[] above because its applicability is itself contradiction-triggered, per §9.2.

label.en: Is FDA Prior Notice applicable (food/beverage import)?
label.es: ¿Aplica el Aviso Previo de la FDA (importación de alimentos/bebidas)?

help_text.en: In the US this includes CBP/ACE filing status.
help_text.es: En EE.UU. incluye el estatus de presentación ante CBP/ACE.

label.es: Estatus de participación en el programa IMMEX

add.applicability_rule_note: any logistics_flows item has destination in MX AND logistics_import_export_license_status is applicable

help_text.en: In Mexico this includes VUCEM filing status.
help_text.es: En México incluye el estatus de trámite ante VUCEM.

label.en: EORI number status (required for EU customs)
label.es: Estatus del número EORI (requerido para aduana de la UE)

add.applicability_rule_note: any logistics_flows item has origin or destination in an EU member state

help_text.en: In the EU this may be an indirect customs representative rather than a traditional broker.
help_text.es: En la UE puede ser un representante aduanal indirecto en lugar de un agente tradicional.

label.es: Contrato(s) firmado(s) con transportista en archivo

label.en: Power of attorney for customs broker on file
label.es: Poder notarial para agente aduanal en archivo

visibility_rules.notes: Also passes through the project-scoped restricted-counterparty redaction pass (free text).
Shown as context, not an actionable instruction to use/avoid a specific carrier.
